title: Tenancy Share of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Free Move-In Waiver
content:
**Acquisition benefit terms.** The free move-in truck of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental is an acquisition benefit for new storage customers, so the waiver tenancy share depends on the storage rent charges billed to the renter in the last twelve months, counted from the rent charge entries on the renter's Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement tenant ledger:

- **12** or more rent charges take **0.85** of the waiver amount;
- two or more but fewer than 12 take **0.95**;
- fewer than two take the whole waiver.

| Storage rent charges billed in the last twelve months | Share of the waiver amount |
|---|---|
| 0 | Whole |
| 1 | Whole |
| 2 | 0.95 |
| 11 | 0.95 |
| 12 | 0.85 |
| 14 | 0.85 |

Only rent charges count toward the number; fees, payments and credits on the ledger do not.
